context: This project: AI Engineering Stuffs consists of subprojects made to accomplished my AI Engineering learning roadmap. I prefer you to create an Article for each subproject under the project's slug (ai-engineering-stuffs) rather than creating a separate project entry.

commands.description: Listed all the commit keywords before the actual commit message. E.g: '(feat): message' this means a new feature.

commitKeys.feat: New feature(s). High chance to create an article BUT still analyze the code changes if worthy to create an article or just work log.
commitKeys.ref: Refactor(s). High change to create a work log BUT still analyze the code changes if worthy to create a work log.
commitKeys.fix: Fix. Low chance or high chance to ignore BUT still analyze the code changes if worthy to create a work log.
commitKeys.others **: Assumpt the commit key. BUT still analyze the code changes if worthy for anything.

subProjectOverview: A learning phase Portfolio Project 1: Self-Correcting Data Extractor & MCP Server. This automates data extraction to the documents powered by AI while maintaining a safe data manipulation to.
targetAudience: AI Engineer, Recruiter, Opensource community, Learner, and Employer
writingTone: Deep-dive engineering with concise code snippets but make it sounds like you are talking to a beginner.
